name: sayarobot
description: sayarobot is a Telegram group-management bot built with Pyrogram, MongoDB, Gemini AI, and Railway deployment support.

BOT_TOKEN.description: Your telegram bot token, get from @Botfather in telegram.

API_ID.description: Get API_ID from my.telegram.org, used for pyrogram base.

API_HASH.description: Get API_HASH from my.telegram.org, used for pyrogram base.

OWNER_ID.description: Your user ID as an integer.

SUPPORT_GROUP.description: Telegram support group username or t.me link.

MESSAGE_DUMP.description: Event logs channel where bot will send updates.

PREFIX_HANDLER.description: Something like '/' to execute commands...Don't give a comma or anything after 1 handler just give and space then enter second hand;ler

DEV_USERS.description: ID of users who are Devs of your bot. Use space to separate values

SUPPORT_CHANNEL.description: Telegram support channel username or t.me link.

SUDO_USERS.description: A space-separated list of user IDs who you want to assign as sudo users.

WHITELIST_USERS.description: A space-separated list of user IDs whitelisted, cannot be restricted.

GENIUS_API.description: Your Genius Client Access Token. Used to fetch lyrics.

BDB_URI.description: Your Mongodb uri different from the previous one to store more info

RMBG_API.description: Your removebackground api to remove the background

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Gemini API key used by the chatbot plugin.

GEMINI_MODEL.description: Gemini model name used by the chatbot plugin.

CHATBOT_DB_URI.description: Optional MongoDB URI for chatbot data. Falls back to DB_URI when empty.

CHATBOT_DB_NAME.description: MongoDB database name for chatbot data.

WORKERS.description: Number of workers to run the bot.

ENV.description: Setting this to ANYTHING will enable environment variables. Leave it as it is
